notes_for_editor: Thin record: the register row, and the province's general statement that every lookout site is staffed by an observer. Two searches and the Mapcarta/OpenStreetMap page (location and tower type only) turned up no history, no observers, no fires, no photos and no description of the site. The brief's access 'closed' and its boilerplate note ('staffed March-October', 'please don't visit uninvited') appear in no source read; access is recorded as restricted with no public-visit source. The brief has no local_unit, so the story names only Alberta. Staffing as_of 2026 reflects the register snapshot read on 2026-10-20.
